stem: A crop observation was linked to the wrong plant ID and must be corrected. What is the strongest record practice?
choices: Keep the wrong ID because records cannot be corrected
Use the controlled correction process so the original entry and corrected identity remain reconstructable
rationale: Use the controlled correction process so the original entry and corrected identity remain reconstructable. This response preserves the Course 002 evidence, identity, role-boundary or documentation principle being assessed.
